content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal to-do list","i_want":"see every one of my tasks in a list that shows each task's status and priority","so_that":"I can see the state of my to-do items at a glance on the to-do management page","business_description":"The to-do management page shows the user's tasks in a task list view. Each row shows the task title, a status indicator (Open, In Progress or Completed) and a priority indicator (Low, Medium or High). The list shows a loading state, an empty state and an error state, and it refreshes from the backend after each confirmed task change.","business_value":"The user can see what is open, in progress, completed and urgent without opening each task, and the list always matches the saved data.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a list containing at least two tasks with different titles","when":"the to-do management page is opened and the read-all request succeeds","then":"the task list view shows every task in the list, each as one row that displays its title"},{"given":"a task with status Open, a task with status In Progress and a task with status Completed in the list","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"each row shows a status indicator whose text is exactly Open, In Progress or Completed matching that task's status"},{"given":"a task with priority Low, a task with priority Medium and a task with priority High in the list","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"each row shows a priority indicator whose text is exactly Low, Medium or High matching that task's priority"},{"given":"the backend read-all request has not yet returned","when":"the task list view is opened","then":"a loading state is shown and no task rows and no empty message are shown"},{"given":"the backend read-all request returns zero tasks","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"an empty state is shown that is visibly different from the loading state and from the error state, and no task rows are shown"},{"given":"the backend read-all request fails with an error response","when":"the task list view is displayed","then":"an error state is shown that is visibly different from the loading and empty states, and no previously loaded task rows are shown as current"},{"given":"the task list view is showing tasks","when":"the user creates, edits, deletes or changes the status of a task and the backend confirms the change","then":"the task list is re-fetched from the backend and the rows reflect the saved change without a manual page reload"},{"given":"the to-do management page is opened","when":"the page requests the task list","then":"the page obtains the tasks from the read-all endpoint provided by US-create-task and does not read tasks from any other source"}],"edge_cases":["The read-all request returns a task whose status or priority is not one of the allowed values: the indicator must not show a guessed value; the PRD does not say how this is shown, so this is an open question.","The list is re-fetched after a change but the re-fetch itself fails: the PRD does not say whether the error state replaces the rows or a message is shown alongside them; this is an open question.","The PRD does not state the order of rows in the task list; this is an open question and no sort order is assumed here.","A task whose title is very long: the PRD does not state a display limit; this is an open question."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-edit-task","US-change-task-status","US-delete-task"],"definition_of_done":["The to-do management page renders one row per task returned by the or High, checked for one task of each value.","Loading, empty and error states are each rendered in a distinct visual form and each is covered by a passing automated test.","The list re-fetches after a successful create, edit, delete or status change, and a test confirms the new row state without a page reload.","No optimistic update is applied: the list changes only after the backend confirms the change.","The open questions about row order, invalid values and refresh failure are recorded in the story notes with the decision taken by the product owner."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"todo-page-task-list-view","title":"[FE] Add to-do management page with task list view of all tasks","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add the to-do
